page.layout: One page of text, no margin notes. Top: dedication heading in larger, spaced capitals and italic, with a stamp at upper right (not transcribed). Below: running text with a woodcut initial "A" at the left. Foot: signature mark at lower left and the last word at lower right.

main_text.head: Nobili, ac singularis spei Adolescenti DOMINO, D. CAROLO TONARDO, DOMINO D'ISON, SEBASTIANVS BASSO. S.
main_text.p: Altero ferè[?] ab hinc anno cum Salmurii, philosophiæ operam dares, Tonarde Musarum, Charitumque deliciæ, rogast me remotum, per literas, ut quædam opuscula, quæ nondum lucem viderunt, ad te mitterem, legendi, ut ajebas, in eisque proficiendi percupidum. Sensi illico non irritam quam Patri tuo dederam fidem; elogiumque singulare, quod præsens ex ore meo retuleras; sed & recordans quæ esset tua indoles, qui in me animus, quàm studiosus, quàm amans mei, credebam facilè te mei causa addu-ctum ea petere, quorum publicatione nimirum, nomini meo lucis aliquid affer-res,

page.notes: The woodcut initial "A" is joined to "ltero" as "Altero". "ferè" has an accent that is hard to read and is marked [?]. "addu-ctum" uses a ct ligature and is marked [?]. The stamp at upper right and the marks at the top left are not printed text and are left out. Long s is written as s throughout, so "fingularis" reads "singularis" and "rogast" reads "rogast".
